<!--

Use BIGINT SQL type for ID columns

SQL integers are signed 32-bit numbers in our supported database engines, except for SQLite. We have seen reports about exceeding that number from users using MariaDB and PostgreSQL.

This PR changes ID columns to `BIGINT` which are signed 64-bit numbers.
